description: Research r14 (dev only, H100): r5 a01_fp32_lr1e-6_skip_cos_mal0 (A 002's recipe with training reward 0 for truncated outputs, full 290-min budget) with truncated importance sampling: each token's policy-gradient term is weighted by min(pi_train / pi_vLLM, 2) (tis_cap 2.0, Yao et al. 2025), and the sampler/trainer mismatch is logged (train_log mismatch_*). r5's three H100 seeds collapsed at steps 375-525, each with a truncation spike after entropy fell to 0.03-0.09 (LOG 10-24 09:40). If the collapse comes from the sampler/trainer mismatch, this removes it; if mismatch_k3 stays tiny, the weights are ~1 and the hypothesis is out.
